relations: Clouds drifting near the left horizon intermittently veil the bright sun, modulating its glow while the sun stays low.
The rippling water surface breaks the vertical reflected light column into a constantly changing shimmering texture.
The silhouetted gazebo on the right and the thin breakwater on the left horizon remain stationary against the sky.
Scattered upper-sky clouds shift subtly, catching warm light along their edges as they move relative to the frame.
caption: The video captures a low, intensely bright sun glowing near the left horizon, partly veiled by sunlit clouds over calm water. A shimmering vertical column of reflected light stretches across the rippling surface, its broken texture changing constantly. Clouds drift slowly around the sun, intermittently modulating its glow while the sun remains near the left horizon. On the right, a dark silhouetted point of land supports a gazebo-like tower with a railing, and both appear stationary against the deep blue sky. Scattered clouds fill the upper sky, catching warm light along their edges as they shift subtly relative to the frame. A thin breakwater line runs along the left horizon, separating the bright sky from the reflective water and remaining along the same horizon line. The visible scene continues through small cloud movement and water shimmer, with the framing appearing steady.
